# Plan

The reverse of the CDF notebook: the x axis is **our** eIF3d TE change at hypoxia 1hr in
MDA-MB-231, for every gene DESeq2 tested, and the curves split genes by Liu's call on METTL13
knockout in T3M4.

**Axis.** `te_lfc` = log2(sictrl / si3d) of translation efficiency (the file name says
`si3d_vs_sictrl`; the coefficient is the reverse). Positive = si3d lowers TE = eIF3d
**promotes** translation.

**Groups.**

- **dDENP** (reddish purple): newly made protein falls on METTL13 KO (P < 0.05), i.e. needs
  eEF1A K55me2.
- **uDENP** (dark blue): newly made protein rises on METTL13 KO (P < 0.05).
- **Detected, unchanged** (dark grey): detected by Liu, P >= 0.05. This is the fair comparator
  for the two DENP curves. Mass spec detects abundant, well-translated proteins first, so
  detected genes are not a random draw from the transcriptome.
- **Not detected** (light grey): every other gene we tested.

# Load

```{r load}
liu_csv <- here("output", "translational_control_overview", "liu2026_eef1a_k55me2",
                "liu2026_table2a_denps.csv")
if (!file.exists(liu_csv)) stop("Run 01_import_denps_volcano.Rmd first: ", liu_csv, " not found")
liu <- read_csv(liu_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(
  nrow(liu) == 2364L, !anyDuplicated(liu$uniprot),
  identical(as.integer(table(liu$denp)[c("dDENP", "uDENP", "Unchanged")]), c(672L, 163L, 1529L))
)

te <- read_csv(here("output", params$te_csv), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(te_lfc))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(te$gene_id_clean), all(is.finite(te$te_lfc)))
cat("Genes with a TE estimate:", nrow(te), "\n")
```

## Check: contrast direction

EIF3D's own RNA must be strongly positive (the siRNA depletes it, so sictrl > si3d).

```{r direction}
eif3d_rna <- te$rna_lfc[te$symbol == "EIF3D"]
cat("EIF3D rna_lfc:", round(eif3d_rna, 2), "\n")
stopifnot("EIF3D rna_lfc not strongly positive - contrast direction flipped" =
            length(eif3d_rna) == 1 && eif3d_rna > 2)
```

## Restrict to primary-assembly genes

Our quantification includes alternate-haplotype and patch copies of some genes (e.g. FLOT1 has
three ENSG IDs). Each copy gets its own TE estimate, and they disagree (FLOT1: 1.00, 0.03,
0.04), so counting them would give one protein several x positions. The GENCODE v49 TxDb
holds primary-assembly genes only, so it decides which copy is real.

```{r primary}
txdb <- loadDb(here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))
primary_ids <- unique(sub("\\..*", "", names(genes(txdb, single.strand.genes.only = FALSE))))
stopifnot("ENSG00000137312" %in% primary_ids,     # FLOT1, primary
          !"ENSG00000236271" %in% primary_ids)    # FLOT1, alt haplotype

n_alt <- sum(!te$gene_id_clean %in% primary_ids)
te <- te %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% primary_ids)
cat("Dropped", n_alt, "non-primary-assembly genes; kept", nrow(te), "\n")
```

# Map Liu proteins to genes

UniProt -> Ensembl gene via `org.Hs.eg.db` (`r as.character(packageVersion("org.Hs.eg.db"))`),
restricted to primary-assembly genes with a TE estimate. A protein encoded by more than one
distinct gene symbol (histone H4: one protein, several H4C genes) cannot be attributed to one
mRNA and is dropped. If two proteins point at one gene with **different** calls, that gene is
dropped too.

```{r map}
map <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = liu$uniprot, keytype = "UNIPROT",
                             columns = "ENSEMBL") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(!is.na(ENSEMBL)) %>%
  distinct(uniprot = UNIPROT, gene_id_clean = ENSEMBL) %>%
  inner_join(te %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol), by = "gene_id_clean")

# Spot-check known accessions
spot <- c(P60228 = "EIF3E", P21980 = "TGM2", P52895 = "AKR1C2", O75955 = "FLOT1")
stopifnot("UniProt spot-check failed" =
            all(map_lgl(names(spot), ~ spot[[.x]] %in% map$symbol[map$uniprot == .x])))
stopifnot("FLOT1 should map to exactly one primary gene" =
            sum(map$uniprot == "O75955") == 1)

multi_symbol <- map %>% group_by(uniprot) %>%
  summarise(n_sym = n_distinct(symbol), symbols = paste(unique(symbol), collapse = ","),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_sym > 1)
cat("Proteins encoded by >1 distinct gene symbol (dropped):", nrow(multi_symbol), "\n")
print(multi_symbol)

gene_calls <- map %>%
  filter(!uniprot %in% multi_symbol$uniprot) %>%
  inner_join(liu %>% dplyr::select(uniprot, denp, liu_log2fc = log2fc), by = "uniprot") %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  summarise(n_prot = n(), n_calls = n_distinct(denp), denp = dplyr::first(denp),
            uniprot = paste(uniprot, collapse = ","), .groups = "drop")

conflict <- gene_calls %>% filter(n_calls > 1)
cat("Genes hit by >1 protein:", sum(gene_calls$n_prot > 1),
    "| with conflicting calls (dropped):", nrow(conflict), "\n")
gene_calls <- gene_calls %>% filter(n_calls == 1)

cat("Liu proteins placed on a gene:", n_distinct(unlist(str_split(gene_calls$uniprot, ","))),
    "of", nrow(liu), "\n")
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(gene_calls$gene_id_clean))
```

# CDF

```{r cdf, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
grp_levels <- c("dDENP", "uDENP", "Detected, unchanged", "Not detected")
grp_colors <- c("dDENP" = "#CC79A7", "uDENP" = "#0072B2",
                "Detected, unchanged" = "grey40", "Not detected" = "grey70")

ambiguous_genes <- map$gene_id_clean[map$uniprot %in% multi_symbol$uniprot]

plot_df <- te %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol, te_lfc, te_padj) %>%
  left_join(gene_calls %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, denp, uniprot), by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
  # genes from dropped ambiguous/conflicting proteins were detected but cannot be called;
  # keep them out of every curve rather than miscounting them as "not detected"
  filter(!gene_id_clean %in% c(ambiguous_genes, conflict$gene_id_clean)) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    denp == "dDENP"     ~ "dDENP",
    denp == "uDENP"     ~ "uDENP",
    denp == "Unchanged" ~ "Detected, unchanged",
    TRUE                ~ "Not detected"
  ),
  group = factor(group, levels = grp_levels))

n_by <- table(plot_df$group)
print(n_by)
stopifnot(all(n_by[c("dDENP", "uDENP")] > 50))

grp_lab <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n = %s)", grp_levels,
                            trimws(format(as.integer(n_by[grp_levels]), big.mark = ","))),
                    grp_levels)

x <- split(plot_df$te_lfc, plot_df$group)
w_d <- wilcox.test(x[["dDENP"]], x[["Detected, unchanged"]])
w_u <- wilcox.test(x[["uDENP"]], x[["Detected, unchanged"]])
w_du <- wilcox.test(x[["dDENP"]], x[["uDENP"]])

p_cdf <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(te_lfc, colour = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = grp_colors, labels = grp_lab, breaks = grp_levels, name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = quantile(plot_df$te_lfc, c(0.005, 0.995))) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2,
           label = sprintf(paste0("Wilcoxon vs detected, unchanged:\n",
                                  "dDENP p = %s, uDENP p = %s\n",
                                  "dDENP vs uDENP p = %s"),
                           format.pval(w_d$p.value, digits = 2),
                           format.pval(w_u$p.value, digits = 2),
                           format.pval(w_du$p.value, digits = 2))) +
  labs(x = "TE log2 fold change, sictrl vs si3d (hypoxia 1hr)",
       y = "Cumulative fraction",
       title = "eIF3d TE change by METTL13 KO call",
       subtitle = "MDA-MB-231 TE; DENP calls from Liu 2026 (T3M4)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98), legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.background = element_blank())

p_cdf

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_03_cdf_te_hypoxia_1hr_by_denp.pdf"), p_cdf, width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
```

The x range is clipped to the central 99% of genes for display; the statistics use every gene.

```{r stats}
plot_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_te_lfc = median(te_lfc),
            pct_eif3d_promoted = 100 * mean(te_lfc > 0.5 & te_padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)

tibble(comparison = c("dDENP vs detected, unchanged", "uDENP vs detected, unchanged", "dDENP vs uDENP"),
       median_diff = c(median(x[["dDENP"]]) - median(x[["Detected, unchanged"]]),
                       median(x[["uDENP"]]) - median(x[["Detected, unchanged"]]),
                       median(x[["dDENP"]]) - median(x[["uDENP"]])),
       wilcoxon_p = c(w_d$p.value, w_u$p.value, w_du$p.value)) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```

**Reading (2026-11-12 knit).** Both DENP classes sit to the right of detected-unchanged by a
similar amount (dDENP +0.036, uDENP +0.061 median TE LFC), and they do not differ from each
other (p = 0.17). So higher eIF3d dependence tracks being METTL13-*responsive*, not the
*direction* of the response, which is not what a shared codon mechanism would predict (the
paper's dDENPs are AU3-rich, uDENPs GC3-rich). The largest shift in the figure is detection
itself: detected genes have median TE LFC 0.38 vs 0.26 for undetected ones, because mass spec
favors abundant, well-translated proteins. The DENP effect is about a quarter of that, so a
residual abundance difference between DENPs and unchanged proteins could account for it and
has not been ruled out.

`pct_eif3d_promoted` is the share of each group in the eIF3d-promoted gene-set definition
(TE LFC > 0.5, padj < 0.05), before the feature-matrix intersection the classifier applies.

  out <- here("output", "translational_control_overview", "liu2026_eef1a_k55me2",
              "liu2026_te_hypoxia_1hr_by_denp.csv")
  plot_df %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol, uniprot, group, te_lfc, te_padj) %>% write_csv(out)
  cat("Wrote", out, "\n")
}
